text:
The primary material of a candle is wax.

In the context of the cyberpunk metropolis described, this simple organic substance stands in stark contrast to the synthetic, high-tech environment surrounding it. While the city is defined by neon, hovercars, and digital omnipresence, a candle represents a return to primal, chemical combustion. The wax itself is typically derived from paraffin (a petroleum byproduct), beeswax, soy, or stearin. In a dystopian setting where resources might be heavily controlled or synthetic, paraffin wax—cheap, mass-produced, and derived from the same fossil fuels that power the city's infrastructure—would be the most common material. It serves as a tangible, flickering anchor to a pre-digital past, its steady burn a quiet rebellion against the chaotic, electric pulse of the neon-lit streets below.
